payload.title: Machine panels framework and ui.panels lesson block (tabs deprecated)
payload.description:
Lessons configure panels through ui.panels; a panel in a scene's show must be configured there; tabs is deprecated. Acceptance:
- web/src/machine/* holds the panels and a useSession hook
- RealStage renders panels from ui.panels
- lesson check fails on a show of an unconfigured panel
- needs: cloud is parsed (used in W3)
- UI strings in web/src/machine/ pass the STE checker through a small spec that collects exported strings
